# Quizzman Fabric — Full LLM Index
> Expanded documentation map for AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, OpenHands, OpenRouter).
> Prefer this file when you need exhaustive links. For a short overview use /qmf/llms.txt.

## Identity
- Product: Quizzman Fabric (Modular Framework + Runtime)
- Short / code: QMF (legacy — `@qmf/*`, `/qmf/`, `QMF` global)
- Stable: 3.0.0 (CDN / @qmf/core stack)
- Alpha: 4.0.0-alpha.1 (vanilla JS contract runtime — @qmf/contract, @qmf/events, @qmf/runtime, @qmf/inspect, @qmf/qmf-cli)
- Home: https://ui.quizzman.com/
- Language (4.0): JavaScript (vanilla ESM). No JSX in Foundation/Runtime/Component/Module layers.

## Coding guidelines for agents
1. Treat qmf.schema.json + module manifests as source of truth (4.0).
2. Prefer vanilla JS ESM for new modules; do not introduce JSX in core layers.
3. Use defineEvent / emit / subscribe — no magic string events without schema.
4. Run doctor (qmf4 doctor) before claiming a module is complete.
5. Read AI_RULES.md and CONVENTION.md before generating files.

## Crawl policy
See https://ui.quizzman.com/qmf/robots.txt
Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes
